ch.x: Do I need to be an expert or have formal qualifications?

No. If you’ve lived through something, solved a problem, or gained experience in any area — you can teach it. This book helps you organize and deliver what you know in a way people value and will pay for.
I have multiple passions. How do I know what to focus on?
You’re not alone.
Infopreneur Roadmap
walks you through how to narrow your focus to something profitable, aligned, and energizing — even if you're multi-passionate.
What if I’ve never sold anything before?
Perfect. This book was written with beginners in mind. You’ll learn how to sell your knowledge with integrity — no sleazy tactics, no fancy tech, no huge audience required.
How long will it take me to launch my info product?
That depends on how fast you move — but many readers start outlining their product within a few days of reading. You can build and launch your first info product in a few short weeks.
Is this book only for coaches?

No. While many coaches love it, this book is for anyone who wants to earn from their knowledge — including consultants, trainers, writers, freelancers, creatives, and even stay-at-home professionals with valuable experience to share.
What if I buy it and realize I’m still not ready?
Even then, you’ll walk away with clarity, direction, and practical tools you can use when you're ready. But if you're already here reading this, you're probably more ready than you think.
